source.title: MASTER GATE — Supplier → Ingestion → Knowledge → Catalog Publish (NO Hub until proven)
source.body:
# BLOCK OWNER & ACCEPTANCE GATE — 2026-10-19

Single acceptance umbrella for all sub-issues in this project. **Do not treat the project as complete because upload/PO screens work or previous feature tickets are Done.** This parent should remain open until verified end-to-end.

## Business outcome

Supplier login → source file received under supplier scope → format recognized/AI-assisted one-time reviewed mapping → row validation + brand/line eligibility → exact Product/SKU matching → (existing) cost/availability/quantity offer update OR (new) ProductCandidate → reusable Brand/Line/Ingredient facts + trusted research + routine metadata + content/packshot/appropriate derived imagery → authorized final review, dedup and publish → linked SupplierOffer → Supplier PO confirmed/Ready with source and quantity truth. Independent audit covers skip/reject/review paths.

## Six milestones, in order

M0 code/test/security audit; M1 source-neutral intake and schema/row pipeline; M2 identity + offer consistency; M3 knowledge/product enrichment; M4 actual browser review/publish and supplier work; M5 cross-domain negative tests + real-export pilot. Linked subtasks define each gated deliverable. Block next phase until current stage evidence passes, but allow selective AI work independent of validated known-offer updates.

## Acceptance (all required)

* Exact supplier-scoped content dedup and correct **format fingerprint** vs Product/SKU fingerprint; versioned approved profile; unknown mapped semantic cost never auto-applies.
* Full and partial imports handle missing vs zero qty and price-only; incomplete full never mass-deactivates; old accepted POs intact.
* Known rows safely update only supplier offers, out-of-scope skip with reason, ambiguous size/variant reviewed, no duplicate product.
* Eligible new candidate acquires verified Product facts and reusable Brand/Line/Ingredient knowledge and formula-aware routine metadata, not invented medical claims or brand logos; source vs derived images clearly distinguished.
* Authorized review/publish creates exact Product/SKU and links supplier, not retail pricing automatically; results visible on storefront and sourcing when sellability/listing prerequisites satisfied.
* Real business UI, tenant isolation, retry/idempotency, concurrency, old-file and AI/media outage; actual DB evidence + signed QA.
* Synthetic tests are developer proof only; real file pilot from launch-relevant supplier software and owner approved mapping semantics required before production go/no-go.

## Execution protocol

Only ChatGPT/owner access Linear, not coding agents. One sequential repo/branch agent scope with clean git audit before touching files; read current code, reuse existing AI FastAPI/Prisma/NestJS/storage; no speculative rewrites, no new ERP integrations, no filler UI. After each stage: changed paths, tested commands/results, schema/API evidence, known blockers, safe restart instruction. No implicit "done" on report alone.

## Relevant prior tickets

AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#1, AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#2, [GLO-75](https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-75/implement-product-ingestion-workflow-and-review-state), [GLO-77](https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-77/implement-product-candidate-review-and-publish-apis), [GLO-97](https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-97/implement-brand-productline-management-apis), AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#8–124, AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#90, AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#3, AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#93. Existing states are historic not end-to-end proof.

## Owner inputs that cannot be fabricated

Sanitized real export samples and exact header meaning per supplier; authoritative brand/line allowlist; supplier purchase-cost and discount rules; source license/verified brand logos, genuine product packshots; working research/media API keys and budget as verified from environment. Do not put keys into Linear or public logs. Claim external pilot BLOCKED until real data and approved semantics exist.

## OWNER COST CONSTRAINT — 2026-10-19, supersedes optional generation acceptance

**AI image generation is DEFERRED, NOT a release/hard-gate blocker.** The Supplier + Product Knowledge pipeline must fully work without paid image generation. Required: verified exact product packshot/source image (or explicit missing-image editorial hold where identity evidence is insufficient), brand logo from authorized source, image storage/transformation, ingredient/Brand/Line facts, text, routine, and honest UI. Ingredient conceptual visuals/lifestyle illustrations are optional and can remain NOT_GENERATED. A provider-independent `ImageGenerationProvider` contract may be documented or lightweight disabled feature flag; do not call paid API, buy a subscription, or require an image-generation key. Choice of a specific model to be benchmarked and enabled only with explicit owner approval near/after production. All existing acceptance criteria about generated visuals are conditional on enabling that future capability; lack of optional generated visual cannot block catalog publication otherwise satisfying factual/media identity rules.

## 2026-10-19 ADDENDUM: Paid Image API NOT a MVP blocker

Owner asked about cost-free/deferred image generation. MVP Gate requires the provider-neutral media workflow and **verified** packshot/logo/derived transformations; optional AI educational ingredient imagery, product lifestyle/editorial art and **paid Google/OpenAI provider activation** are DEFERRED until owner budget/production decision. API keys and paid image smoke tests are not prerequisites to close this block. If the model is disabled, never claim an image was generated; include optional visuals' source/prompt job metadata and a clear deferred state. All product fact/research/routine/content/media approval and storefront truthful publication remain required.
